name: spendchat
description: A minimal, chat-style money tracker — add, view, filter, download, and print your income and expenses.
author: Playxoft
//types: Read by the /design-sync converter only (generated by .design-sync/regen.mjs into the gitignored dist/types). The app is private and never consumed as a dependency, so this affects no build, test, or deploy.

scripts.//typecheck:design: Type-checks .design-sync/ (previews, provider, stubs), which `typecheck` cannot see — TypeScript's include globs skip dot-directories. Regenerates ds-entry.ts first, because the previews import the component library through it. Run before a design-system re-sync.
scripts.preview: doppler run -- opennextjs-cloudflare build --env production && doppler run -- sh -c 'CLOUDFLARE_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_HYPERDRIVE=$NEON_POSTGRES_DATABASE_URL WRANGLER_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_HYPERDRIVE=$NEON_POSTGRES_DATABASE_URL opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env production'
scripts.deploy:dev: doppler run --config dev -- opennextjs-cloudflare build --env beta && doppler run --config dev -- sh -c 'CLOUDFLARE_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_HYPERDRIVE=$NEON_POSTGRES_DATABASE_URL WRANGLER_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_HYPERDRIVE=$NEON_POSTGRES_DATABASE_URL opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env beta'
scripts.deploy:prod: doppler run --config prd -- opennextjs-cloudflare build --env production && doppler run --config prd -- sh -c 'CLOUDFLARE_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_HYPERDRIVE=$NEON_POSTGRES_DATABASE_URL WRANGLER_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_HYPERDRIVE=$NEON_POSTGRES_DATABASE_URL opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env production'
scripts.//db:health: Storage-cap check + rate-limit-log retention sweep. DELETES from ai_usage_log/email_send_log by default — pass -- --no-prune (or --dry-run) to report only. Exits 1 past --warn-at (default 80% of neon.max_cluster_size), 2 on bad usage or an unreadable cap, 3 on failure.

pnpm.//overrides: Transitive packages our dependencies still pin below a security advisory. EVERY entry is bounded to the dependent's declared major (0.x: to its minor), because an unbounded override silently breaks the dependent the day a new major ships: an earlier version of this block forced protobufjs 8 onto @grpc/proto-loader, which declares ^7.2.5. Re-derive the list after any dependency change rather than carrying it forward — removing firebase-admin alone made five of the original nine entries unnecessary. DELIBERATELY NOT OVERRIDDEN: esbuild. Both of its advisories are esbuild's own dev server (a CORS hole, and a Windows file read); wrangler and drizzle-kit use it as a library and never start that server, and wrangler pins esbuild to an exact 0.27.3 because it drives the plugin API — so the override would risk the deploy toolchain to silence something that cannot affect us.
